source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: mime_part_address returns allocated data from strdup or PR_MALLOC and releases only its recursive temporary. The original new classifier stores its parent address in a raw const char pointer without a visible release in that branch. Accepted code instead adopts the result into nsAutoCString. Preserve that local ownership change separately from the original classifier behavior; this is static allocation/lifetime evidence, not a measured leak or a general string-wrapper rule.
title: The CMS classifier now adopts its allocated MIME parent address
